requirement: Each requirement and example definition badge MUST link to its own anchored definition on the current page. The badge MUST have a separate adjacent link containing an accessible right-arrow icon in an integrated segment matching the badge color linking to its evidence detail page. The badge and arrow MUST remain aligned in one non-wrapping row. Definitions MUST NOT be followed by a separate plaintext evidence link. Each detail page MUST link back to the definition's anchored badge and to the index. Reference badges MUST continue to link to the definition. These links MUST resolve when a requirement name contains `.md`, as in `requirements.cli.mdbook`.
rationale: The reviewed tests cover each obligation in `requirements.index.navigation`. One thin spot is noted at the end. - **Badge links to its own anchor on the current page.** `definitions_without_a_marker_get_a_default_index_and_detail_pages` asserts `id="habeas-{kind}-rules.{name}" href="#habeas-{kind}-rules.{name}"` for a requirement, an example and a `.md`-containing name. `index_shows_evidence_states_and_links_generated_chapters` asserts the same for `requirements.core.ready`. - **Separate adjacent arrow link to the evidence detail page.** - `mdbook_preprocessor_renders_definitions_between_stdin_and_stdout` splits out each `habeas-definition-badge` span. It asserts each span has an `` elements, so the arrow is a separate link. It also asserts the badge `href` is `requirements-index/rules.ready.html`. - `index_owns_details_in_book_order_with_badge_icons` asserts the `title="View evidence" aria-label="View evidence for …"` attributes, a white `stroke="#fff"` icon, and an index placed in a nested directory. - `definition_evidence_link_targets_are_escaped` asserts the `aria-label`, and the escaped detail href when the index path contains special characters. - `citation_metadata_is_hidden_in_fenced_sections_and_preserved_in_details` asserts `habeas-detail-icon` and the detail href for req and example definitions. - **Integrated segment matches the badge color.** `definition_badge_and_evidence_icon_share_colors` extracts the badge color from the shield URL and the icon's `background-color`, and asserts they are equal for both a requirement and an example. - **One non-wrapping aligned row.** `definition_badge_stylesheet_keeps_the_arrow_in_one_row` asserts the stylesheet rules `inline-flex`, `align-items: center`, `flex-wrap: nowrap`, `white-space: nowrap`, `flex-shrink: 0` on the links, and the icon's centering and height. - **No separate plaintext evidence link.** `index_owns_details_in_book_order_with_badge_icons` and `definitions_without_a_marker_get_a_default_index_and_detail_pages` both assert that "See evidence" is absent. - **Detail pages link back to the anchored badge and the index.** - `definitions_without_a_marker_get_a_default_index_and_detail_pages` asserts `[Requirements index](../requirements-index.html)` on every detail page. It asserts `[View definition](…#habeas-req-…)` for the `.md` name and a nested chapter. - `index_shows_evidence_states_and_links_generated_chapters` asserts the index link, the "View definition" link and the adjacency of the two. - `index_owns_details_in_book_order_with_badge_icons` asserts the example-kind back-link. - **Reference badges still link to the definition.** `references_in_nested_chapters_link_to_the_requirement_definition` asserts that impl, cite and test badges in a nested chapter link to `../requirements.html#habeas-req-requirements.ready`. - **Names containing `.md`.** - `links_preserve_requirement_names_containing_md` asserts `chapter_href` output for both the detail link and the definition anchor link. - `definitions_without_a_marker_get_a_default_index_and_detail_pages` and `index_owns_details_in_book_order_with_badge_icons` assert the escaped `%2Emd` forms end to end. **Weakest point.** No test asserts the direction of the arrow glyph, which is the `` in the SVG. The tests check the icon's presence, its accessibility attributes, its stroke and its color. The accessible label and the link target are asserted, and the glyph shape is a visual detail the text states only as "right-arrow". I do not treat this as a gap that outweighs the otherwise thorough coverage.
